name: menubar
title: Menubar
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova menubar, fixed: The theme's shadow-md and shadow-lg are shadow-float, so its popup drops shadcn's ring, which doubled the shadow's hairline; its rows are 32px tall (min-h-8) with an 8px radius, as in every menu. Its spacing on the 4px module (docs/grid.md). It pops in and out by the theme's motion-pop (in at 150ms on --ease-enter, out at 100ms on --ease-exit), not shadcn's 100ms on `ease`.
